description_en: Queries the details of a database export ticket
description_zh: 获取数据库导出工单详情
name: GetDatabaseExportOrderDetail

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The ticket ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html operation to obtain the ticket ID
parameters.help_zh: 工单ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: order_id

DatabaseExportOrderDetail.description_en: The details of the database export ticket

Comment.description_en: The business background information of the database export ticket
Comment.description_zh: 提交数据导出工单的业务背景

Committer.description_en: The user who submitted the ticket

CommitterId.description_en: The ID of the user who submitted the ticket. This ID is a user ID and is not the ID of an Alibaba Cloud account
CommitterId.description_zh: 工单提交者的用户ID，非阿里云UID

KeyInfo.description_en: The key information about the ticket

AuditDate.description_en: The time when the ticket was submitted

Config.description_en: The configuration information about the ticket

ExportContent.description_en:
The type of data that was exported. Valid values:

DATA: The data of the database was exported.
STRUCT: The schema of the database was exported.
DATA_STRUCT: The data and schema of the database were exported
ExportContent.description_zh:
导出内容。取值如下：

DATA：数据。
STRUCT：结构。
DATA_STRUCT：数据和结构

ExportTypes.description_en: The type of schema that was exported

items.description_en:
Valid values:

PROCEDURE
FUNCTION
TRIGGER
VIEW
EVENT
items.description_zh:
取值如下：

PROCEDURE：存储过程。
FUNCTION：函数。
TRIGGER：触发器。
VIEW：视图。
EVENT：事件

SQLExtOption.description_en: The extension options of the SQL script

items.description_en:
Valid values:

DROP: A DROP TABLE statement is generated before the CREATE statement.
TRUNCATE: A TRUNCATE TABLE statement is generated before an INSERT statement.
COMPRESS: The values to be inserted by an INSERT statement is compressed to 5 MB
items.description_zh:
选项列表：

DROP：在CREATE语句前生成DROP TABLE语句。
TRUNCATE：在INSERT语句前生成TRUNCATE TABLE语句。
COMPRESS：压缩INSERT语句，将VLAUES合并为5 M大小

SelectedTables.description_en: The tables that were exported from the database

TargetOption.description_en:
The format in which the database was exported. Valid values:

SQL
CSV
XLSX
TargetOption.description_zh:
导出格式。取值如下：

SQL
CSV
XLSX

DownloadURL.description_en: The URL that is used to download the export result

Log.example:
2023-04-12 14:58:32:015 Database Dump Start.
2023-04-12 14:58:32:096 set server side query timeout, sql : set max_execution_time = 0

SearchName.description_en: The name that is used to search for the database

StatusDesc.description_en: The status description of the ticket

WorkflowStatusDesc.description_en: The status description of the workflow

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to query logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
